sources.author: Harrison Chase
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ LangChain
sources.post_summary: Discussed the rapid evolution of AI agents and how LangGraph is enabling more reliable multi-step agent workflows. Highlighted real production use cases where agents are moving beyond demos into enterprise deployments.

sources.author: Simon Willison
sources.headline: Co-creator of Django, AI researcher
sources.post_summary: Shared insights on the current state of AI tooling and why most 'AI agents' still require significant human oversight. Emphasized practical developer tooling improvements over hype around autonomous agents.

sources.author: Kelvin Liew
sources.headline: Head of AI Infrastructure @ Scale AI
sources.post_summary: Detailed the infrastructure challenges of running large-scale AI agents in production, including memory management, cost optimization, and observability. Shared metrics from their internal agent deployments.

sources.author: Santiago Valdarrama
sources.headline: ML Engineer & Educator
sources.post_summary: Explained how developers can build reliable automation pipelines using current AI tools without over-engineering. Focused on practical patterns for integrating LLMs into existing developer workflows.

sources.author: Elena Voss
sources.headline: Head of GTM Engineering @ Ramp
sources.post_summary: Discussed building a GTM engineering function that sits between product and sales, using data pipelines to score ICP fit and automate lead enrichment. Shared how their team reduced time-to-first-meeting by 40% by embedding outbound signals directly into CRM workflows.

sources.author: Marcus Hale
sources.headline: Founder & CEO @ OutboundOS
sources.post_summary: Explained how his team built an outbound automation stack combining Clay, Instantly, and custom scoring models. Highlighted the shift from volume-based outreach to signal-driven sequences that improved reply rates by 3x while cutting wasted sends.

sources.author: Priya Sharma
sources.headline: VP Revenue Operations @ Notion
sources.post_summary: Shared a framework for aligning content strategy with revenue operations by mapping content assets to specific funnel stages and buyer personas. Emphasized using attribution data to double down on high-converting content types rather than vanity metrics.

sources.author: David Kline
sources.headline: Director of Sales Operations @ Deel
sources.post_summary: Detailed how his team operationalized GTM experiments using a centralized RevOps dashboard that tracks experiment velocity, win rates, and pipeline impact. Stressed the importance of giving sales teams self-serve access to experiment results.

sources.author: Sofia Patel
sources.headline: GTM Engineer @ Vercel
sources.post_summary: Wrote about building internal tooling that connects product usage data directly to outbound sequences, allowing sales to trigger personalized outreach based on feature adoption signals rather than static lists.

sources.author: Alex Finn
sources.headline: Founder @ SideProjectLab | Ex-Google | Shipping in public
sources.post_summary: Shared his journey building and launching a niche productivity tool over 8 weeks as a solo founder. Highlighted the decision to skip a full MVP and instead release a single core feature that solved one painful workflow for freelancers.

sources.author: Priya Sharma
sources.headline: Software Engineer → Indie Developer | Career Pivot Advocate
sources.post_summary: Detailed her transition from a 6-year corporate engineering role into full-time indie development. Posted weekly updates on her first paid product, including how she validated demand through cold outreach to 40 potential users before writing code.

sources.author: Marcus Chen
sources.headline: Founder of DevToolsCo | Shipping micro-SaaS in public
sources.post_summary: Posted a transparent breakdown of his latest micro-SaaS launch, including failed experiments, the exact tech stack used, and how he reached $2k MRR within 6 weeks by posting daily progress threads on LinkedIn.

sources.author: Elena Rodriguez
sources.headline: Former PM turned Solo Builder | Product at 0 to 1
sources.post_summary: Shared lessons from pivoting out of product management into solo building. Focused on how she used her PM skills to scope a tiny tool for other PMs and validated it through 15 customer interviews before shipping.

sources.author: Jordan Hale
sources.headline: Full-stack dev building in public | Ex-startup engineer
sources.post_summary: Documented his decision to leave a stable startup job to build a developer tooling product solo. Posted code snippets, user feedback loops, and the exact pricing experiments that led to his first 50 paying users.
